movers.text: Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
Starter Jordan Scott (23 mpg, shoulder) was limited in practice after the loss at Tennessee and is questionable vs. Detroit Mercy; Tom Izzo said decisions come game day.
Starter Coen Carr (22 mpg, knee tendinitis) was limited in practice and is questionable vs. Detroit Mercy; Izzo downplayed the injury as not serious.
